core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hassaan corresponds to the Arabic form حسان (Arabic root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); حَسَّان (Ḥassān)). Its core sense is good, beautiful, virtuous, excellent. Hassaan is Arabic حَسَّان (Ḥassān) 'very good, very beautiful', an intensive form from the root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n). It is a well-documented Arabic personal name, borne by the poet Hassan ibn Thabit.
